issues.description: Method getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() with return type int, while the template's inline hint in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java suggests a double return type and the solution implementation in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java implements it as double. This mismatch between UML and code-level artifacts will confuse students about which return type to implement and may cause compilation or test failures depending on which artifact the tests and instructions follow.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: update the UML entry in problem_statement.md to declare getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double (to match the template hint and the solution implementation), and add a short note in the problem text explaining why double is used (precise calculation). Alternatively, if integer division is intended, change the template comment and the solution method to return int and update implementation accordingly. Ensure tests and examples use the chosen type.
